title: Smooth Jazz Hear and Now CD Norah Jones Chris Botti Boney James Dave Koz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Smooth Jazz: Hear and Now - Various Artists
(Jazz Alliance International D2-83508, 2003). BMG Direct D 151759.
Proceeds benefit Jazz Alliance International.

14 tracks featuring Norman Brown, Chris Botti, Norah Jones, Peter White,
Joe Sample, Marc Antoine, Jeff Lorber, Al Jarreau, Dave Koz with
Luther Vandross, BWB, Brian Culbertson, Euge Groove, Fourplay and
Boney James.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
